name: Catharine Ball
sources: Ancestry.com, 1860 United States Federal Census (District 2, McMinn County, Tennessee)
Ancestry.com, 1870 United States Federal Census (District 8, Roane County, Tennessee)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree" (tree 4662169)
notes: Child of David Tate Ball and Draden (Davis) Ball; a sister of Ellen Rogers (Ball) McPhail. In the household in 1860 and 1870. The tree calls her Dradie Catherine Ball and gives her death as 7 May 1917 in Mobile County, Alabama. Lead: a Tennessee death record names a Drady Katherine Ball as the wife of Joseph L. Fox and mother of George Browder Fox.
